title: Data Schedules and Learning Rate Schedules Should Be Designed Together
abstract: arXiv:2610.29348v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mid-training (MT) is a training phase in LLM training pipelines that continues pretraining (PT) on smaller datasets of higher value. Taking the PT and MT phases as a whole, training usually starts with only PT data and then transitions completely to MT data. In this work, we view this complete transition from PT to MT data as a special case of a broader class of data mixing schedules that specify how the proportions of PT and MT tokens in each batch change over training. Under fixed total training compute and MT token budgets, we ask: Is this complete transition to MT data optimal for minimizing final MT loss? We show that the answer depends on the learning rate (LR) schedule: one data schedule may outperform another under one LR schedule, but changing only the LR schedule can reverse the outcome. translated_title: 数据调度与学习率调度应当协同设计
translated_abstract: 中期训练是大语言模型训练流程中的一个阶段，它在规模更小但价值更高的数据集上继续进行预训练（PT）。将预训练与中期训练两个阶段作为一个整体来看，训练通常从仅使用预训练数据开始，然后完全过渡到中期训练数据。在本工作中，我们将这种从预训练数据到中期训练数据的完全过渡视为更广泛的一类数据混合调度的特例，这类调度规定了每个批次中预训练与中期训练token的比例如何随训练过程变化。在固定总训练计算量和中期训练token预算的条件下，我们提出这样的问题：这种向中期训练数据的完全过渡对于最小化最终中期训练损失是否是最优的？我们表明，答案取决于学习率（LR）调度：在某种学习率调度下，一种数据调度可能优于另一种，但仅改变学习率调度就可能逆转这一结果。具体而言，当学习率在继续训练过程中持续衰减时，更早引入中期训练数据并将其与预训练数据混合，可以降低最终的中期训练损失。
tldr: 研究表明数据调度与学习率调度必须协同设计：中期训练中最优的数据过渡策略依赖于学习率调度，当学习率持续衰减时，更早引入中期训练数据并与预训练数据混合能降低最终损失。
en_tdlr: Data schedules and learning rate schedules should be designed together: the optimal data transition strategy in mid-training depends on the LR schedule, and when the LR decays, introducing mid-training data earlier and mixing it with pretraining data lowers the final MT loss.
